_comment: Country-pack defaults of settings (slice S1.08 ruling P4; S1.09a review finding 1, CR-061). Until country packs exist (S1.23) they are the pack layer of a setting for a company of that country: computed, never stored, shown as layer 'pack' by the settings resolver. The pack loader then writes them as stored pack values and this file is removed. Keys are setting keys; each setting listed must allow the pack layer in its manifest.
